DataForSEO provides services based on a pay-as-you-go model without restricted API bundles. This model gives you full control over the cost you’ll be paying and complete freedom to choose the APIs you’ll be using.

To use [DataForSEO Backlinks API](https://dataforseo.com/apis/backlinks-api?amp), you’ll need to [sign up for the Backlinks API access](https://app.dataforseo.com/backlinks-subscription) using a dedicated payment form. Once you fill it in, you will be charged for $100 monthly. Basically, it is not a fee for access to this API alone since **the funds will remain on your account balance** and you can spend them on any API usage. This sum is just a small commitment we ask for not to overload our evolving backlink infrastructure.

Importantly, **you can spend the funds from your account balance on Backlinks API or on any other of our APIs**. For example, if you’d like to obtain SERP data or get some keyword ideas in addition to backlinks, you’re welcome to do so. Roughly, on $100 you can analyze over 660,000 backlinks, get over 44,000 SERPs using the standard queue, and check metrics in real-time for over 440,000 keywords altogether.

### How to activate the subscription

1 Go to the [Access Subscriptions page.](https://app.dataforseo.com/api-access-subscriptions)

2 Click *Activate* under *Backlinks API* in your account dashboard. Then click *Gain Access*.

3 Once a dedicated payment form opens, **fill in the necessary fields and make the payment**.

**That’s it**. You can start using the Backlinks API endpoints right away.

**Note:** The subscription **does not automatically become available** if you already use auto-recharge, and the sum of your regular replenishment is over $100, or if you have already added over $100 to your account balance this month. You should still **activate the Backlinks API access separately** and **top up your account through a dedicated payment form**.

In case you’d like to subscribe, but need to spend more than $100 monthly, you can always add more funds using one-time or auto-recharge options.

#### Do I gain access to both Backlinks API and LLM Mentions API if I pay $100/mo?

No, the Backlinks API and the LLM Mentions API have separate subscriptions. Paying $100/month for one product (for example, the Backlinks API) only applies to that specific API and does not automatically include the other. If you also want to use the LLM Mentions API, you need to activate it separately and make a separate monthly top-up for that product.

### How Backlinks API is priced

The pricing of [Backlinks API](https://dataforseo.com/apis/backlinks-api?amp) is based on the charge per API request ($0.02) and per each retrieved data row ($0.00003). Note that you can extract a maximum of 1,000 rows with one API request. You can review the total cost for different volumes of requests and data rows in the table below.

| API requests | 1 | 1 | 100 | 1,000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rows | 1 | 1,000 | 100,000 | 1,000,000 |
| Cost | $0.02 + $0.00003 = **$0.02003** | $0.02 + $0.03 = **$0.05** | $2 + $3 = **$5** | $20 + $30 = **$50** |
To review the pricing for Backlinks API and our full data offering, please refer to [our pricing page.](https://dataforseo.com/pricing/backlinks/backlinks?amp)
